017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter;
018
019import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
020
021/**
022 * Decides whether a request came from a page this application served, and supplies the CSRF token such a page embeds.
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * {@link RequestBoundaryFilter} applies an implementation to every request and answers refusals; other callers that
026 * judge a raw request directly (a message-bus session endpoint, say) call {@link #check(HttpServletRequest)} the same
027 * way.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * Implementations judge a request on its <b>effective</b> method, via
031 * {@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.MethodSafety#effectiveMethod(String, String, java.util.function.UnaryOperator)},
032 * so a safe request line that claims a write through a method override takes the write checks.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * Rejections are built only inside this package ({@link BoundaryResult}'s rejecting constructor is package-private),
036 * so an implementation outside it can only {@linkplain BoundaryResult#ALLOWED allow}.
037 *
038 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
039 *    <li class='jc'>{@link LoopbackBoundary}
040 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RequestBoundaryFilter}
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * @since 10.0.0
044 */
045public interface RequestBoundary {
046
047   /**
048    * Applies the boundary to a request.
049    *
050    * @param req The request to check.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
051    * @return {@link BoundaryResult#ALLOWED} when every applicable check passed, else the first rejection encountered.
052    */
053   BoundaryResult check(HttpServletRequest req);
054
055   /**
056    * The name of the header a state-changing request must carry the CSRF token in.
057    *
058    * @return The CSRF header name.
059    */
060   String csrfHeader();
061
062   /**
063    * The CSRF token value a page served in answer to {@code req} must embed.
064    *
065    * @param req The request being answered.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
066    * @return The value to embed.
067    */
068   String tokenFor(HttpServletRequest req);
069}
